gbm_population_evidence.quote: Grade III or Grade IV Glioma
Histological diagnosis of primary WHO grade III or IV glioma

gbm_population_flag.reason: Grade IV glioma is eligible but glioblastoma is named only in the detailed description, not in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels.

candidate_evidence.quote: This study will examine whether positron emission tomography (PET) imaging with fluciclovine can reliably differentiate true progression from pseudoprogression months earlier than the conventional MRI methods.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Enlarging or new contrast-enhancing mass suspicious for progression/recurrence (at least 10mm in one direction)

role_evidence.quote: PET with 18F fluciclovine injection, 185 MBq (5 mCi) ± 20%, delivered as an intravenous bolus

agents.drug_class_hint: 18F-labelled amino acid PET tracer (isotope fluorine-18); imaging only

coder_notes: Diagnostic PET trial (Phase 3 as registered). Eligible population is WHO grade III or IV glioma; glioblastoma is mentioned only in the detailed description, so by manual 1.1 note C7 it is coded high_grade_glioma_unspecified. If an adjudicator reads grade IV glioma as historical glioblastoma it would still fail S6 (no pharmacological antitumour candidate).
